title: [Radio’ Clock] Tea Time Monday with SUNNY (써니)
description:
다르게 생겼지만, 어떻게 화장을 하느냐에 따라서 다른 사람과 닮아질 수 있다니!
금손 유튜버 써니씨와 함께 했는데요.

애슐리에게 해준 화장으로 분위기를 확! 바꿔주었는데요!
새로운 느낌, 기분을 내고 싶을 땐 화장으로 변화를 줘보는 건 어떨까요!💓

Today we spent time together with the beauty YouTuber Sunny.
She is famous for cover makeup. By her makeup, you can look like someone else depending on how you put on it!

Ashley also changed the mood by putting on Sunny's makeup.
So if you want to create a new feeling or mood, why don't you change it with makeup!💓
